headline: 5 arrested for honey-trap blackmail in Dhaka
summary: The DB police have dismantled a gang that lured victims into flats, assaulted them and recorded compromising videos to extort money.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has arrested five people for allegedly running a honey-trap blackmailing ring.
The gang members, identified as Anwar Hossain, Badiuzzaman Shahin, Mariyam, Shahadat Hossain, and Urmi Begum, were arrested during raids in Sabujbagh, Badda, and Khilgaon areas of the capital.

According to DB, the gang lured victims by establishing close relationships through phone calls after an initial meeting. One victim, a loan officer of a private financial institution, was lured to a flat in Khilgaon.
Once inside the flat, the victim was assaulted by four other gang members and forced into a compromising position with a woman to record a video.
The gang then seized the victim's phone, wallet, cash, ATM cards, NID, and other important documents, demanding 3 lakh BDT for their return.
The victim reported that the gang extorted 1.10 lakh BDT from his bank account via mobile financial services (MFS) and continued to blackmail him with the threat of leaking the video.
DB officials stated that preliminary investigations suggest multiple people have been trapped using the same method. The five suspects are currently in police remand.

headline: Gas outage: 16-hour gas outage on Tuesday for several areas
summary: Multiple regions in Bangladesh will face a significant disruption in gas supply on Tuesday.
details: Several areas across the country will experience a gas outage on Tuesday.
The disruption is expected to last for 16 hours, affecting residential and commercial users.
Authorities have announced the outage to facilitate necessary maintenance or technical adjustments in the supply lines.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to plan their activities accordingly to avoid inconvenience.
